4247-6835-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

628-3108-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.
628-3108-4247.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

2866-3899-4211-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

824-2292-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2292-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2292-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2459-2511-3184.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3129-5478-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
3129-5478-6441-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

907-1558-3875-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-3875-4231-7824.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-3734.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-3734.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Progenitor Mimic and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-3734.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2447-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2447-3259-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4289-6968-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-6968-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-6968-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

618-1518-4456-7494.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
618-1518-4456-7494.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to draw two cards and causing instant, sorcery and planeswalker spells you cast to cost {2} less to cast until your next turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Will Kenrith.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2

4556-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4556-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

224-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull is a creature and has at least two charge counters on it.
224-5967-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Hearthhull
Repeat.

2034-2060-2744-5660--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2034-2060-2744-5660--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2034-2060-2744-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

1479-2841-6156-6528.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-6528.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

874-1170-1329-2198.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-2198.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3284-3490-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2173-2275-5078.description:
Activate Sense's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

147-2034-3645.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2267-4798-5435-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2267-4798-5435-5686.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

687-1628-1833-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Tayam.
Stormbound Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
687-1628-1833-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {C}{C}.
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability and Necrosynthesis trigger.
Resolve the Stormbound Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Necrosynthesis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Tayam, and both counters from Stormbound Geist.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Stormbound Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1882-2290-4613.notablePrerequisites: Gideon's Company has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1882-2290-4613.description:
Activate Gideon's Company using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Gideon's Company triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.

618-3525-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control a non-legendary creature.
618-3525-4050.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any non-legendary creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

2282-3593-5231.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Immortal Phoenix from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Immortal Phoenix, adding {R}.
Immortal Phoenix dies, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1309-2104-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Salvager of Secrets.
1309-2104-4305.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Repeat.

2254-2400-5261.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six creatures in your graveyard.
2254-2400-5261.description:
Spend {2} and tap to activate Isochron Scepter, casting Songs of the Damned and triggering Onyx Talisman.
Pay {3} for the Onyx Talisman trigger, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Allow Songs of the Damned to resolve, adding at least 6 {B}.
Repeat for infinite {B}.

618-821-1053-2240-2943.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
618-821-1053-2240-2943.description:
Cast Goblin Recruiter by paying {1}{R}.
Search your library for Mogg Fanatic, Kiki-Jiki, Torch Courier, and Conspicuous Snoop, and put them on top of your library in that order.
Draw a card by any method.
Cast Conspicuous Snoop by paying {R}{R}.
Cast Torch Courier from the top of your library by paying {R}.
Activate Torch Courier by sacrificing it, giving Conspicuous Snoop haste until end of turn.
Activate Conspicuous Snoop using the ability gained due to Kiki-Jiki being on the top of your library by tapping Conspicuous Snoop, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 7 for infinite tapped token copies of Conspicuous Snoop.
Activate your untapped token copy of Conspicuous Snoop by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goblin Recruiter.
The Goblin Recruiter token enters the battlefield, searching your library for Mogg Fanatic and putting it on top of your library.
Sacrifice an arbitrarily large number of Conspicuous Snoop tokens using the ability gained due to Mogg Fanatic being on top of your library for an arbitrarily large amount of damage.
